blocks.prompt: 10. Find the equation of the circle touching the \(y\)-axis and also the straight line \(3x - 4y = 0\) at the point \((8, 6)\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do "touch" ki shartein hain: circle \(y\)-axis ko bhi chhoota hai aur line \(3x - 4y = 0\) ko ek maloom point \((8, 6)\) par.
Diya kya hai? Tangent \(y\)-axis, aur tangent line \(3x - 4y = 0\) with point of contact \((8, 6)\).
Find kya karna hai? Circle(s) ki equation; aage quadratic aayegi, is liye do circles ki tawaqqo rakhein.
Rule kaunsa? \(y\)-axis ko touch karna: \(r = |h|\). Line ko \((8, 6)\) par touch karna: centre normal par, aur \(r = |CP|\).
Plan: normal ki equation, centre us par, phir dono radius barabar kar ke \(h\).
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \(y\)-axis ko touch karta hai aur \(3x - 4y = 0\) ko \((8, 6)\) par touch karta hai.
Maloom karna: circle(s) ki equation.
Tareeqa: Centre \(C(h, k)\) farz karein. \(y\)-axis se faasla \(|h|\) hai, wohi radius. Line ko \((8, 6)\) par chhoone se centre normal par hoga, aur \(C\) se \((8, 6)\) ka faasla bhi radius hoga.

\((8, 6)\) par normal
\[3x - 4y = 0 \Rightarrow m = \tfrac{3}{4}\]
\[y - 6 = -\tfrac{4}{3}(x - 8)\]
\[4x + 3y - 50 = 0\]
Kyun: Pehle check: \(24 - 24 = 0\), point line par hai. Line ka slope \(\frac{3}{4}\), to normal ka \(-\frac{4}{3}\) (product \(-1\)). \(3y - 18 = -4x + 32\) se normal mila.

Centre normal par
\[4h + 3k = 50,\quad k = \tfrac{50 - 4h}{3}\]
\[k - 6 = \tfrac{32 - 4h}{3} = -\tfrac{4}{3}(h - 8)\]
Kyun: \(C(h, k)\) normal ki equation ko satisfy karta hai. \(k - 6\) ko \((h - 8)\) mein likh liya taake aagla qadam aasaan ho.

Radius do tareeqon se
\[(h - 8)^2 + (k - 6)^2 = h^2\]
Kyun: \(|CP|^2 = r^2\) aur \(r = |h|\), to \(r^2 = h^2\).

Rakh kar hal karein
\[(h - 8)^2 + \tfrac{16}{9}(h - 8)^2 = h^2\]
\[25(h - 8)^2 = 9h^2\]
\[5(h - 8) = \pm 3h\]
\[h = 20 \text{ or } h = 5\]
Kyun: \((k - 6)^2 = \frac{16}{9}(h - 8)^2\). 9 se multiply: \(9 + 16 = 25\). Dono taraf perfect squares hain, to root lene se \(\pm\) aaya: \(5h - 40 = 3h\) se \(h = 20\), aur \(5h - 40 = -3h\) se \(h = 5\).
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(+\) wala root lene se ek circle chhoot jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{|15 - 40|}{5} = 5,\quad \dfrac{|60 + 40|}{5} = 20\]
Kyun: Har centre se line \(3x - 4y = 0\) ka faasla us ke radius ke barabar hai, aur \(y\)-axis se faasla \(|h|\) bhi radius hai. Figure mein dekhiye: ek chhota circle line ke upar, ek bara neeche, dono \((8, 6)\) par line ko chhoote hain.
